dfb757a6d914e370.title: Uncovering the transcriptional hallmarks of endothelial cell aging via integrated single-cell analysis
digest: The Human Aging Endothelial Cell Atlas reveals how gene expression patterns of the human endothelium change with age, identifying reduced angiogenesis, altered mechanical signaling and a conserved gene program linked to endothelial senescence.

c3b99a6899ee8396.title: Transcriptomic reprogramming screen identifies SRSF1 as a regulator of aging
digest: Plesa, Jung and colleagues conduct an in vitro transcriptomic reprogramming screen and identify splicing factor SRSF1 as capable of reducing transcriptomic age without loss of cell identity; they then implicate SRSF1 as a regulator of aging in worms and mice.

c9c3ebbfc5a67a27.title: Brain DNA methylation, APOE genotype and Alzheimer’s disease neuropathology in a large postmortem cohort
digest: A large-scale study identified 107 brain DNA methylation sites linked to Alzheimer’s pathology, with 38 replicated independently.
DNA methylation partially mediated the association between APOE genotype and Alzheimer’s diagnosis.

04f61e8b5f610381.title: Chaperone-mediated autophagy curbs senescence
digest: Sereda and colleagues show that chaperone-mediated autophagy declines with aging, which leads to enhanced senescent cell burden that is driven, in part, by failed macrophage-mediated immunosurveillance that can promote tissue dysfunction and systemic aging.

694534d080f3a761.title: Type 2 immunity as a counter-regulatory axis in aging
digest: Chronic low-grade inflammation is a hallmark of aging, but the endogenous programs that normally restrain it are far less understood than its drivers.
Type 2 immunity is classically linked to allergy and anti-helminth defense, yet it also acts as a homeostatic circuit that preserves hematopoietic, macrophage and metabolic homeostasis.

4e8585b4130b1f23.title: Flagship Pioneering merges three of its companies for AI drug discovery
digest: Flagship Pioneering is combining three of its portfolio companies, including one that has been around for a decade, in an effort to compete in the bustling AI drug discovery field.
The Cambridge, MA-based incubator and ...

f8f4758a56ebbf3d.title: E11 Bio - Scientist I/II - Advanced Imaging
digest: E11 Bio is on a mission to advance connectomics towards the scale of whole mammalian brains.
We are a collaborative and interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers engaged in a neuroscience moonshot project to develop a radical technology platform for scalable brain mapping.

07d30d200896609b.title: Recordanelles capture transient gene expression in single human cells
digest: RNA sequencing can capture high-resolution snapshots of a cell’s transcriptome, but transient changes in individual cells cannot be captured over long periods at a transcriptome-wide scale.
Now, a synthetic organelle termed the ‘recordanelle’ can record cellular RNAs in cells for several days and be read with single-cell sensitivity.

3b08ebf26aca6aa7.title: Deep dynamical models of single-cell multiomic velocities predict loss-of-function and rescue perturbations in B cells
digest: DynaVelo integrates single-cell omics data to infer cell state dynamics and regulatory interactions.

7ea8611065f07224.title: Suppressing neural stem cell PLA2G7 restores inhibitory circuit function and improves cognition in aging mice
digest: Wu, Wu and colleagues identify PLA2G7, a secreted lipid-metabolizing enzyme, as a negative regulator of inhibitory synapses in the dentate gyrus.
Suppression of PLA2G7 in neural stem cells enhances synaptic transmission and cognitive performance in aged mice.

af6cc2fc2c972030.title: Senescent-like activated naive B cells contribute to progression to clinical rheumatoid arthritis
digest: Applying single-cell multiomics to people at risk of rheumatoid arthritis, Wu, Zhang, Moon and colleagues identify an expansion of activated, senescent-like B cells associated with disease development.
These cells express poly- and autoreactive antibodies and present self-antigens to T cells.

d6e4b2de314dd5b8.title: Group Lead, Immunology
digest: About NewLimit NewLimit is a biotechnology company working to radically extend human healthspan.
We’re developing medicines to treat age-related diseases by reprogramming the epigenome, a new therapeutic mechanism to restore regenerative potential in aged and diseased cells.

digest: A Chinese biotech startup has raised more than $100 million in Series A funding for its AI-driven protein design.
